# Pesty

> A free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS with a color-coded strip, searchable history, pinboards, and keyboard navigation.

## Current direct release
- Version: 1.3.0
- Release notes: https://github.com/momenbasel/pesty/releases/tag/v1.3.0
- Requirements: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple Silicon or Intel
- License: MIT
- Download: https://github.com/momenbasel/pesty/releases/latest

## Features
Pesty supports text, rich text, links, images, files, and colors. It includes editable search, one-click content-type filters, named pinboards, image previews, clip editing, plain-text and Markdown pasting, drag-and-drop, multi-select, history retention by count or age, and five-minute undo for clip deletion.

Default shortcut: Shift-Command-V. Arrows select clips; Return chooses a clip; Command-1 through Command-9 choose the first nine clips. Command-Shift-F cycles the content-type filter (All, then each type present in the current collection). Shortcuts can be configured.

## Editions and privacy
The direct-download and Homebrew builds are free. They can paste directly with Accessibility permission. iCloud Drive sync is optional and off by default.

The paid Mac App Store edition is sandboxed. Selecting a clip copies it and returns focus to the target app; press Command-V to paste. It uses private CloudKit sync, enabled by default and controllable in Settings. The two editions use separate sync systems.

There are no developer-run clipboard servers, ads, or analytics. Clips marked concealed or transient are skipped. Users can exclude apps or pause capture; sensitive values without these markers can still be recorded. Local history uses restricted file permissions.

## Install with Homebrew
Review the maintainer's tap, then run `brew tap momenbasel/pesty`. On Homebrew 7, run `brew trust --tap momenbasel/pesty`, then `brew install --cask momenbasel/pesty/pesty`.
